title: Track provenance of Magical Secrets / Tome / Book spell picks
description: Level-up stores Magical Secrets, Pact of the Tome and Book of Ancient Secrets picks in spellcasting.known/cantrips without provenance, so the optional spell replacement can offer them (a Book ritual or off-list secret that is also on the class list) as replaceable. Record provenance (feature ref) per spell if the SRD wording needs the distinction.
notes:
2026-10-08 (Claude Captain reconciliation): keep at source-semantic disposition. First establish from SRD text whether any rule or consumer distinguishes Magical Secrets / Tome / Book picks from ordinary known spells (e.g. replacement eligibility). Do NOT add per-spell provenance schema unless that rule or a demonstrable consumer requires it; a 'no distinction needed' disposition closes this bead.
PR opened 2026-10-09 (#635); supervisor reviewed + verify green; final Sol review queued after limit reset.
Disposition corrected after Sol review eshyra-3lq2.2: Magical Secrets DID need a fix (off-list leveled secrets must be replaceable; old-spell eligibility = leveled spell in known). Book of Ancient Secrets -> ritualBook bucket with ownership-aware exclusions. Pact of the Tome needed no change.
